name: linkedin-agent
description: Eleven reusable LinkedIn workflows for writing, engagement, planning, profile optimization, repurposing, outreach, inbox triage, auditing, and humanization.

interface.shortDescription: Eleven reusable LinkedIn writing and workflow skills.
interface.longDescription: A skills-only LinkedIn workflow pack for ChatGPT and Codex. Draft posts, comments, replies and DMs; plan content; repurpose long-form material; audit performance; improve profiles; triage inboxes; and humanize drafts. Nothing is auto-published.
defaultPrompt: Use LinkedIn Agent to turn this idea into a LinkedIn post.
Use LinkedIn Agent to plan my LinkedIn content for this week.
Use LinkedIn Agent to humanize this draft before I publish it.
